# tm

C's `tm`: a calendar time broken into its components.

```rux
pub struct tm {
    pub tm_sec: int32;
    pub tm_min: int32;
    pub tm_hour: int32;
    pub tm_mday: int32;
    pub tm_mon: int32;
    pub tm_year: int32;
    pub tm_wday: int32;
    pub tm_yday: int32;
    pub tm_isdst: int32;
    pub tm_gmtoff: int64;
    pub tm_zone: *char8;
}
```

Two of the fields are traps rather than conveniences, and both are C's rather than this binding's: `tm_year`
counts from 1900, so 2026 is 126, and `tm_mon` counts from zero, so December is 11. `tm_sec` reaches 60 for
a
leap second.
Declared once per system because the field order and the trailing members differ; the nine standard fields
are
the same everywhere and are all this declares.

**See also**: [https://en.cppreference.com/c/chrono/tm](https://en.cppreference.com/c/chrono/tm)

## Fields

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                       |
| ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tm_sec`    | `int32`  | Seconds after the minute [0, 60].                                                                 |
| `tm_min`    | `int32`  | Minutes after the hour [0, 59].                                                                   |
| `tm_hour`   | `int32`  | Hours since midnight [0, 23].                                                                     |
| `tm_mday`   | `int32`  | Day of the month [1, 31].                                                                         |
| `tm_mon`    | `int32`  | Months since January [0, 11].                                                                     |
| `tm_year`   | `int32`  | Years since 1900.                                                                                 |
| `tm_wday`   | `int32`  | Days since Sunday [0, 6].                                                                         |
| `tm_yday`   | `int32`  | Days since January 1 [0, 365].                                                                    |
| `tm_isdst`  | `int32`  | Daylight saving time flag.                                                                        |
| `tm_gmtoff` | `int64`  | Seconds east of UTC. A BSD and glibc extension, not in standard C. (Linux · macOS · FreeBSD only) |
| `tm_zone`   | `*char8` | The time zone's abbreviation, in storage the C runtime owns. (Linux · macOS · FreeBSD only)       |
